title: 第1章 卧槽有挂第2章 九天神雷斩妖除魔
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
义庄，房间里。
【叮！宿主消耗100技能点，五雷咒从入门提升至小成！】
【叮！宿主消耗500技能点，五雷咒从小成提升至大成！】
【叮！宿主消耗1000技能点，五雷咒从大成提升至大圆满！】
“不是，哥们！”
林凡眼睛一亮，听着脑海里的声音发愣。
怎么也没想到，一秒一个技能点，竟然是真的？
等你十八年可算来了，系统！
十八年前，林凡作为穿越者来到这个满是鬼怪与僵尸，以及妖魔层出不穷的乱世。
要不是九叔当年好心将其收养，视如己出
想必早已死于各类妖魔鬼怪之手。
回想起这18年间，对着这一眼望到头的平凡日子，林凡可谓是心如死灰。
林凡作为大师兄，天赋也不过比秋生、文才好些。
在这末法年代，根本和天才不沾边。
哪怕说好听点，也只能勉强算还行。
好歹也是个穿越者，基本标配的系统却迟迟不出现。
直到今夜十八岁生辰，系统才终于出现。
还是个如bUG一般的一秒一个技能点的系统……
“五雷咒大圆满……”
林凡忍不住感叹起来。

每阶分为【入门、小成、大成、大圆满】四个境界。
雷法乃是道门至尊之法，修炼极难，天赋、努力缺一不可。
文才如今，连五雷咒的边都摸不到。
秋生还好些，偶尔瞎猫撞上死耗子，还能响个雷鸣。
林凡多年努力，也不过是三年前，才终于可以习得五雷咒。
三年不断练习，五雷咒也不过堪堪入门！
如今，短短几分钟，系统竟把五雷咒提升至大圆满？
简直是天方夜谭！
别说后天境界了，就是先天，乃至人师又如何？
这可是雷法，道法至尊！
以后天之资习得大圆满境界的五雷咒，林凡怕也是当今第一人！
拥有这么个系统，等同坐拥无数个帮自己日夜修炼之人。
content_en:
Yizhuang, in the room.
【bite! The host consumes 100 skill points, and the Five Thunder Spells are upgraded from beginner to accomplished! 】
[Ding! The host consumes 500 skill points, and the Five Thunder Spells are upgraded from minor to major! 】
[Ding! The host consumes 1,000 skill points, and the Five Thunder Curse is upgraded from Dacheng to Dzogchen! 】
"No, man!"
Lin Fan's eyes lit up and he was stunned listening to the voice in his head.
I never expected that one skill point per second would actually be real?
It’s been eighteen years since I’ve waited for you, system!
Eighteen years ago, Lin Fan came to this troubled world full of ghosts, zombies, and demons as a time traveler.
If Uncle Jiu hadn't been kind enough to adopt him and treat him as his own,
He must have died at the hands of various monsters and monsters.
Looking back on the past 18 years, Lin Fan was filled with despair as he looked at the ordinary days that came to an end.
As a senior brother, Lin Fan's talent was only better than Qiu Sheng and Wen Cai.
In this law-ending age, genius has nothing to do with it.
Even if you put it nicely, it's just barely okay.
After all, he is also a time traveler, but the basic standard system has not yet appeared.
It wasn't until tonight, my eighteenth birthday, that the system finally appeared.
It’s still a bug-like system with one skill point per second...
"The Great Perfection of the Five Thunder Curses..."
Lin Fan couldn't help but sigh.
Each level is divided into four realms: [Entry, Small Success, Dacheng, and Dzogchen].
Thunder method is the supreme method of Taoism. It is extremely difficult to practice. Talent and hard work are indispensable.
The literary talent is now unable to even touch the edge of the Five Thunder Curse.
Qiu Sheng was better. Occasionally, a blind cat would bump into a dead mouse, and it would make a thunderous sound.
After years of hard work, Lin Fan was finally able to learn the Five Thunder Curse only three years ago.
After three years of continuous practice, the Five Thunder Curse is no more than a beginner!
Now, in just a few minutes, the system has upgraded the Five Thunder Curse to Dzogchen?
It’s simply a fantasy!
Let alone acquired realm, what about innate and even human teacher?
This is the thunder method, the supreme Tao method!
Lin Fan is probably the first person today to learn the Five Thunder Mantras of the Dzogchen realm with the talent of tomorrow!
Having such a system is equivalent to having countless people who help you practice day and night.
